outcomeNote: Single anonymous mishna ruling; no parties interact.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ לֹא יָצַק, לֹא בָּלַל, וְלֹא פָּתַת, וְלֹא מֶלַח, וְלֹא הֵנִיף, לֹא הִגִּישׁ, אוֹ שֶׁפְּתָתָן פִּתִּים מְרוּבּוֹת, וְלֹא מְשָׁחָן – כְּשֵׁירָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If one «did not pour» the oil onto the meal offering, or «did not mix» the oil into the meal offering, «or did not break» the loaves into pieces, «or did not» add «salt, or did not wave» the omer meal offering or the meal offering of a sota, or «did not bring» the meal offering to the altar, «or» if it happened «that» the priest «broke» the meal offerings that require breaking into «greater pieces» than appropriate, «or did not smear» oil on the wafers requiring this (see Leviticus 2:4), in all these cases the meal offering is «fit.»

positions.claim: a meal offering remains fit even if pouring, mixing, breaking, salting, waving, bringing, or smearing was omitted, or it was broken into large pieces
